# The Tyee

> The Tyee is BC's independent news source delivering investigative journalism, political analysis, and solutions-focused reporting from Vancouver and across British Columbia.

The Tyee covers Canadian news with a focus on British Columbia politics, policy, and public affairs. The publication combines investigative journalism with opinion and analysis pieces, serving as a key resource for understanding local and provincial issues affecting the region.

## Key Topics

- British Columbia
- Canadian News
- Investigative Journalism
- Politics & Policy
- Public Affairs
- Analysis & Opinion
- Local News
- Vancouver
- Alberta
- Iran
- Trump

## Home & Navigation

- [The Tyee Homepage](https://thetyee.ca): BC's home for today's news, analysis and updates from Vancouver
